name: Nice
preview: Sarah: Anytime. Good luck out there.

messages.text: Nice, that's the cheap end — about $29 a month for the B30's 405 W at 10¢, against $899 for the unit. Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?
Currently I have 3 bitaxe gamma 601s, I also have two desktops and one laptap mining as well

You're well past the Bitaxe stage — three Gammas is maybe 3.5 TH total, the B30 is 30 TH in one quiet box for about $29 a month at your rate.

That's roughly ten times your current shot at a block, drawing every ten minutes, forever. Want me to put one in the cart? Ships November 30, 2026.
Before you go, one thing: what's holding you back on the B30?

Fair enough — $899 is real money.

Is it the whole $899, or would splitting it over a few payments make it work? Afterpay is on the store for US buyers.
it something I'll have to think about

Makes sense. It's Batch 5, 50 units, ships November 30 — so there's no rush tonight, but batches do sell out.

I'm here whenever you want the numbers run again. Happy mining with the Gammas in the meantime.

context.pop: At 10¢ the Harlo B30 runs about $29 a month, at 16¢ about $47 — what do you pay for power?
